rule: Keep only bbox bottom-centre at or below the image floor centreline as a near-floor-side candidate. Put boxes above it into net_boundary_review. Both classes still need team and floor-contact review.
limitations: The line is a staged calibration from one frame, not a player-side truth label.
Airborne or occluded near-side players can cross the image line and need review.
A far-side player can still pass the box-bottom screen during overlap.
A six-candidate count does not validate six teammates, identities or floor positions.
